existing_boundary: NativeRepositoryFrontier is a frozen type label, not an installed concrete Python task schema in the reviewed UDM source.
Machine.safe_task admits exact original E/D task hashes; installed native adapters separately admit pinned TOML and two collection worlds. They must not be silently widened.

Current adapters have supplied observation and constructor grammars. Their activation or patch instantiation is not new grammar acquisition.

FLASH readiness is a derived causal routing projection; it is not a universal scientific checker.

smallest_generic_bridge.obligation: A fixed project-native whole-suite command can independently check bounded native behavior. An unfamiliar source repository with already passing tests has no demonstrated unsatisfied developmental obligation merely by being unfamiliar.
contract_fields: immutable upstream repository and commit/tree digest
fixed standard upstream-native pytest-all verifier recipe and trusted runner bytes
admissible candidate patch paths and immutable test/config/verifier boundary
frozen observation and constructor language source hashes
exact causal ancestors and capability generation
protocol/freeze digest and fresh verification session identity
smallest_generic_bridge.minimal_execution: Materialize a fresh detached source tree with git replace objects disabled; verify tracked bytes, no redirected paths or executable untracked/ignored imports; apply an authenticated candidate production patch; preserve authoritative upstream tests/config; invoke the frozen full-suite recipe in a fresh process/environment; collect exact outcomes and import/test-source identities; independently repeat accepted consequences against a clean source clone; admit only an exact source/scope/program/receipt/dependency binding.
smallest_generic_bridge.reuse: Reuse Machine Capability/CAS/Metatron append and liveness; extend installed adapter-specific FLASH validator dispatch rather than caller-supplied validate authority. Reuse original native pytest invocation semantics as precedent, but its current changed-test-file list and target-specific stateful probes are not a generic full-suite verifier.
smallest_generic_bridge.limits: Frozen pytest checks original native assertions within declared suite/environment only. It proves neither broad semantic correctness nor developmental causality, complete expressivity obstruction, hostile code safety or prospective unfamiliar-source growth.

authority_and_evidence.ability_warrant_permission: Keep executable bytes, independent native evidence, and externally supplied execution permission distinct. Acquisition cannot append itself broader authority.
authority_and_evidence.ceiling: Pinned local research trees and native tests only; external-effect permission unchanged. Scientific scope checks are not non-bypassable containment.
authority_and_evidence.non_bypassable_monitor: UNKNOWN: public Python functions, Machine.append, imports and subprocess capabilities remain bypassable by a process with workspace authority.
authority_and_evidence.receipt_replay: Require source tree, test/config/verifier bytes, environment, task/obligation, candidate hash, exact ancestor IDs, generation and protocol/session binding. A retained valid receipt can support its exact immutable scope, but restoration must create fresh independently executed evidence and new lineage; old receipt cannot be relabeled fresh.
authority_and_evidence.oracle_independence: Candidate producer must not supply expected results, edit authoritative tests/conftest/config/runner, replace pytest plugin or intercept import paths. Project tests can be independent normative assertions while being visible to search, provided pre-freeze information rules are preserved. They are not statistically held-out merely because native.
authority_and_evidence.threat_scope: Against deliberately hostile candidate Python, in-process pytest instrumentation and same-user files are forgeable; either narrow the declared scientific threat model or qualify separate enforcement. Do not call local-source integrity a hostile-agent sandbox.

minimum_decisive_tests: Native non-target control executes actual upstream whole-suite assertions with nonzero executed count and exact source import identity.
No tests, skipped-only, timeout, collection/import/environment error, malformed receipt remain UNKNOWN; exit zero alone cannot warrant PASS.
Modification of tests/conftest/config, untracked or ignored import shadowing, stale pyc and Git replacement objects rejected.
Candidate that merely removes a failing assertion or suppresses pytest execution rejected.
Forged receipt and receipt replay from another task/generation/environment/source rejected.
Missing or altered executable/CAS objects and invalid/withdrawn constructor ancestors rejected.
Exact ancestor revocation reopens all dependent registered FLASH frontiers before next routed execution; unrelated withdrawal leaves native behavior unchanged.
Restoration reexecutes frozen independent native verifier, uses fresh evidence/new generation, and does not reactivate old revoked support.
Separate-process restart reconstructs from immutable state and executes actual native capability under current source/liveness checks.
Corrupted persisted state and derived-ready cache cannot grant execution.
Matched cold/O1/O1+O2/O1+O2+O3/sham conditions run the same source, primitives, verifier and declared horizon; every actual call, timeout, failure and setup/acquisition/maintenance cost retained.
Strong executable-ledger baseline has same source, evidence, operators/observations, total resource budget and retained programs; ties reported.
O1 removal changes actual subsequent observations/search rather than an artificial admission flag; O2 is generated and natively executed, not selected from supplied target answers.

O3 changes future selection/observation/constructor/retention execution and yields a further protected outcome or fully charged cost benefit; supplied controller activation is not autonomous controller invention.
